roles: row supplies actor 0; column supplies actor 1; role indices never exchanged
diagonal: Reuse verified original-pair evaluations, identical model hashes and evaluation seeds
off_diagonal: Six ordered role-specific pairings, 30 fresh Unity-process episodes each; no exploration, learning, checkpoint selection or retries
metrics: Per-cell mean of max undiscounted agent return, within-cell population SD, both agent-return means; signed self-play gap = row diagonal mean minus cell mean
aggregation: Diagonal and off-diagonal means descriptive only; six off-diagonal cells share actors, not six independent training seeds; no CI or significance
truncation: If any episode in a cell externally truncates, withhold cell aggregate; do not hide failed pairings
limits: Legacy local_done internal timeout ambiguity; only three trained seeds and fixed actor roles; not arbitrary-partner generalization
